errors.text_span: on a logarithmic scale along the x-axis
errors.evidence: The x-axis does not use a logarithmic scale; the tick marks are placed at custom, non-uniform intervals (0.02, 0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.5) but are not spaced according to a logarithmic function.
The y-axis has no label. Stating what it represents is an interpretation based on context, not a description of the visual information presented in the chart.

errors.text_span: TU begins at 0.125 and remains nearly constant until σ_q = 0.2
errors.evidence: The TU line does not remain constant until 0.2. It is constant until 0.1 and then begins to rise, increasing from approximately 0.125 to 0.13 between σ_q = 0.1 and σ_q = 0.2.

errors.text_span: EU remains close to 0.000 for σ_q from 0.02 to 0.2
errors.evidence: The EU line does not remain close to 0.000 until 0.2. It visibly starts to increase after σ_q = 0.1, reaching a value of approximately 0.01 at σ_q = 0.2.
